description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-filenode-server/tests/common/mod.rs (MemoryBackend) and tests/filenode_tests.rs covering all spec cases. MemoryBackend is a full HashMap-backed implementation of all FileNodeBackend methods.

**MemoryBackend structure:**
- nodes: HashMap<(account_id, node_id), FileNode>
- blobs: HashMap<(account_id, blob_id), u64> (blob_id → size)
- states and change_log per account per type
- get_ancestors: walk parentId links in HashMap
- get_descendant_ids: BFS over parentId index
- blob_exists: check blobs map
- find_sibling_by_name: scan nodes with matching parentId
- Implement all 6 FileNodeBackend contract methods plus JmapBackend

**Test cases (spec-grounded, no code-as-oracle):**
- FileNode/get: basic fetch, fetchParents expansion, notFound.
- FileNode/changes: after create, after destroy.
- FileNode/set create: nodeType inference (directory/file/symlink), blobId validation, onExists null/replace/rename, compareCaseInsensitively.
- FileNode/set destroy: onDestroyRemoveChildren=false leaf, =false with children (nodeHasChildren), =true cascade.
- FileNode/copy: cross-account copy, onExists on copy.
- FileNode/query: basic, with parentId filter, with depth=1, with depth=2.
- FileNode/queryChanges.

Each test has a comment citing the spec section it validates.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- cargo test -p jmap-filenode-server exits 0 with all new tests.
- No test derives expected values from code under test.
title: Integration tests: MemoryBackend covering all 6 handlers
